nodes.label: $this->
nodes.rationale: Reserved by this convention for instance property access.

nodes.label: Instance context
nodes.rationale: Scoped calls to instance methods require an instance context.

nodes.label: parent::
nodes.rationale: Calls inherited implementations.

nodes.label: self::
nodes.rationale: The default for same-class instance and static method access.

nodes.label: static::
nodes.rationale: Used for methods intended to be overridden in extensible classes.

nodes.label: Generated Markdown
nodes.rationale: Hand editing is forbidden except for documented gates.

nodes.label: Impersonal voice
nodes.rationale: The shared voice rules are canonical.

nodes.label: One home per fact
nodes.rationale: Canonical placement prevents divergent duplication.

nodes.label: PHP glossary
nodes.rationale: Terminology follows docs/glossary.md.

nodes.label: Relative links
nodes.rationale: Local links are relative; cross-repository links use commit permalinks.

nodes.label: Function
nodes.rationale: A named function outside a class-like structure.

nodes.label: Instance Method
nodes.rationale: A non-static method requires an instance.

nodes.label: Instance Property
nodes.rationale: Each instance holds its own non-static property value.

nodes.label: Method
nodes.rationale: A function declared in a class, trait, enum, or interface.

nodes.label: Static Method
nodes.rationale: A static method can be called without an instance.

nodes.label: Static Property
nodes.rationale: A property shared by the class-like structure.

nodes.label: Agent instruction
nodes.rationale: An instruction layer must pass composer check:instructions.

nodes.label: Compliant and noncompliant fixtures
nodes.rationale: Concrete examples establish the proposed convention.

nodes.label: PHPCS sniff
nodes.rationale: Token-based analysis follows staged approval gates.

nodes.label: PHPStan rule
nodes.rationale: Type-aware analysis follows the same staged gates.

nodes.label: Policy status
nodes.rationale: Authorship does not establish policy adoption.

nodes.label: Trait and Interface
nodes.rationale: Shared implementation and contracts are assessed separately.

nodes.label: Major
nodes.rationale: Known changes to package interaction require a major release.

nodes.label: Minor
nodes.rationale: New functionality preserves existing interaction.

nodes.label: On-demand releases
nodes.rationale: A schedule is not assumed unless recorded in the README.

nodes.label: Patch
nodes.rationale: Defect fixes preserve existing interaction.

nodes.label: Semantic Versioning 2.0
nodes.rationale: Packages follow the specification as closely as possible.

nodes.label: Zero-major
nodes.rationale: Rapid architectural change uses minor versions for changed interaction and patches for compatible additions or fixes.

nodes.label: Guard
nodes.rationale: Fails closed and uses PHP 8.5 NoDiscard for critical authorization results.

nodes.label: Handler
nodes.rationale: Terminates the pipeline with the final domain result.

nodes.label: Middleware
nodes.rationale: Delegates downstream or short-circuits a layered pipeline.

nodes.label: Property Hooks
nodes.rationale: Native get/set hooks encapsulate backed or virtual properties.

nodes.label: Unsupported examples
nodes.rationale: Fragments require application-provided types and are not package APIs.

nodes.label: Voter
nodes.rationale: Evaluates permissions without mutation and returns Granted, Denied, or Abstain.

nodes.label: Classes prefix
nodes.rationale: Class conventions start with Classes rather than Class.

nodes.label: Convention folders
nodes.rationale: PHPCSSniff.php and PHPStanRule.php live under src/Analysis/<Convention>.

nodes.label: Experimental analysis
nodes.rationale: Experimental files mirror the structure without Composer autoloading.

nodes.label: PHPStan identifiers
nodes.rationale: Identifiers begin eightfold. and use the lowercased first character of the convention name.

nodes.label: RFC 2119
nodes.rationale: PascalCase convention names use Must, MustNot, Should, ShouldNot, or Can.

nodes.label: Boolean negation
nodes.rationale: Prefer positive conditions or explicit === false/=== true comparisons over unary !.

nodes.label: Comparison operators
nodes.rationale: != and !== are not unary negation and remain permitted.

nodes.label: Evaluation order
nodes.rationale: Preserve grouping, short-circuiting, and behavior.

nodes.label: Noncompliant fixtures
nodes.rationale: Intentional violations remain evidence for diagnostic tests.

nodes.label: Operand type
nodes.rationale: Nullable, non-boolean, and unknown operands require intent analysis rather than mechanical replacement.

nodes.label: Expected behavior
nodes.rationale: States the promise against which a defect is assessed.

nodes.label: Impact and workaround
nodes.rationale: Records blocked work and available alternatives without assigning severity.

nodes.label: Observed behavior
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes reported experience from verified evidence.

nodes.label: Reproduction
nodes.rationale: Records safe steps, versions, environment, and verification limits.

nodes.label: Verification
nodes.rationale: Identifies a test or manual check exposing the defect.

nodes.label: Acceptance criteria
nodes.rationale: States observable success conditions.

nodes.label: Alternatives
nodes.rationale: Records existing approaches and their trade-offs.

nodes.label: Need and impact
nodes.rationale: Records what becomes possible or less costly.

nodes.label: Policy status
nodes.rationale: Separates requests, maintainer proposals, adoption, and external requirements.

nodes.label: Requested capability
nodes.rationale: Describes an outcome rather than prescribing an implementation.

nodes.label: Community leaders
nodes.rationale: Leaders clarify and enforce conduct standards.

nodes.label: Correction
nodes.rationale: Unprofessional behavior may receive a private warning.

nodes.label: Harassment-free community
nodes.rationale: Participation is inclusive across personal characteristics.

nodes.label: Permanent Ban
nodes.rationale: Patterns of harmful conduct can permanently prohibit participation.

nodes.label: Reporter privacy
nodes.rationale: Reports are reviewed while protecting the reporter.

nodes.label: Temporary Ban
nodes.rationale: Serious sustained violations can suspend interaction.

nodes.label: Annoying
nodes.rationale: A workaround exists or behavior could be improved.

nodes.label: Broken
nodes.rationale: Behavior does not work as promised.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits
nodes.rationale: Each commit has one change classification.

nodes.label: Cumulative qualitative triage
nodes.rationale: Combined supported impact categories guide attention; the rubric is not RICE or a score.

nodes.label: Decision boundary
nodes.rationale: Recommendations alone authorize neither metadata changes nor implementation.

nodes.label: New by policy
nodes.rationale: Requires a recorded policy proposal, adoption, or external requirement.

nodes.label: New user request
nodes.rationale: Outside demand remains recorded after policy escalation.

nodes.label: Re-engineering
nodes.rationale: Observable behavior or an explicit developer-facing contract changes.

nodes.label: Refactoring
nodes.rationale: Internal restructuring preserves observable behavior and explicit contracts.

nodes.label: Security/Accessibility
nodes.rationale: The highest-ranked impact category routes attention.

nodes.label: Tracking and wontfix
nodes.rationale: Unresolved tracking readiness is explained; wontfix is excluded from active recommendations.

nodes.label: Default PR template
nodes.rationale: Only one default template exists at .github/pull_request_template.md.

nodes.label: HTML editor guidance
nodes.rationale: Editor prompts are comments rather than rendered submitted content.

nodes.label: Reusable-file inventory
nodes.rationale: Changes preserve bin/efqs mappings and the README inventory.

nodes.label: Reusable prompts
nodes.rationale: Templates must not assume consuming-project infrastructure.

nodes.label: YAML frontmatter
nodes.rationale: Issue-template frontmatter must remain valid.

nodes.label: Change classification
nodes.rationale: Classify meaningful refactoring and re-engineering changes in separate commits.

nodes.label: Follow-ups
nodes.rationale: Record related work intentionally left out.

nodes.label: Problem and Cause
nodes.rationale: Separate the defect or need from evidence explaining it.

nodes.label: Test and contract changes
nodes.rationale: Disclose altered, removed, and skipped assertions or contracts.

nodes.label: Validation evidence
nodes.rationale: Record exact commands, results, skipped checks, and baseline failures.

nodes.label: GitHub security advisory
nodes.rationale: The preferred reporting channel keeps details private until a fix lands.

nodes.label: Initial assessment
nodes.rationale: The policy targets an assessment within 72 hours.

nodes.label: Private vulnerability disclosure
nodes.rationale: Potential vulnerabilities go to the security team, not public issues.

nodes.label: Security patches
nodes.rationale: The policy targets applying patches within two weeks.

nodes.label: Acceptance criteria
nodes.rationale: Makes migration and eventual removal verifiable.

nodes.label: Policy status
nodes.rationale: Filing a proposal does not authorize removal.

nodes.label: Replacement and migration
nodes.rationale: Records compatibility, notice, and migration requirements.

nodes.label: Supported capability
nodes.rationale: Identifies an API, rule, instruction, command, or behavior to retire.

nodes.label: CallableEvaluators
nodes.rationale: The callable experiment depends on missing types and an unimplemented rule.

nodes.label: CallableSubtypeInference
nodes.rationale: The fromFlags sketch refers to missing base types and undeclared cases.

nodes.label: Excluded experimental tests
nodes.rationale: Tests are outside the supported PHPUnit suite and include a pre-existing fixture parse error.

nodes.label: Unsupported experimental API
nodes.rationale: Drafts are outside Composer autoloading and cannot run as-is.

nodes.label: Copyright notice
nodes.rationale: Copies and substantial portions retain the notice.

nodes.label: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
nodes.rationale: The project names this license.

nodes.label: Warranty disclaimer
nodes.rationale: The software is provided as-is without warranty.

nodes.label: Adapter
nodes.rationale: A dedicated wrapper is the recommended alternative.

nodes.label: Composition
nodes.rationale: An instance can be injected through the constructor.

nodes.label: Trait
nodes.rationale: Shared behavior can use horizontal composition.

nodes.label: Attribute opt-out
nodes.rationale: The {{attributeName}} placeholder names the alternative decoration.

nodes.label: Required-rule tip
nodes.rationale: The {{mustTip}} placeholder reuses the stronger rule's tip.

nodes.label: Attribute opt-out
nodes.rationale: The {{attributeName}} placeholder names the alternative decoration.

nodes.label: Required-rule tip
nodes.rationale: The {{mustTip}} placeholder reuses the stronger rule's tip.

nodes.label: Explicit comparison
nodes.rationale: For boolean operands, replace !expression with expression === false while preserving grouping and short-circuiting.

nodes.label: Explicit boolean negation
nodes.rationale: The diagnostic requires explicit comparison or a positive condition.

nodes.label: Final declaration

nodes.rationale: Class {{className}} must be declared final.

nodes.label: Prohibited inheritance
nodes.rationale: Class {{className}} must not extend another class.

nodes.label: Advisory finality
nodes.rationale: Class {{className}} should be declared final.

nodes.label: Advisory inheritance restriction
nodes.rationale: Class {{className}} should not extend another class.

nodes.label: $this method access
nodes.rationale: The diagnostic prohibits accessing a method through $this.

nodes.label: Name placeholder
nodes.rationale: The details text interpolates {{name}}.

nodes.label: Composer install
nodes.rationale: The startup instructions require lock-file installation, not an unsolicited update.

nodes.label: Convention workflow
nodes.rationale: New convention requests follow the fixture-first workflow.

nodes.label: Impersonal voice
nodes.rationale: Descriptions focus on the work, evidence, and reality rather than participants.

nodes.label: Knowledge graph refresh
nodes.rationale: The Graphify skill refreshes existing code and prose before other startup work.

nodes.label: Semantic usage evidence
nodes.rationale: Unavailable measurements must not be reported as measured zero.

nodes.label: Shared rules and agent context
nodes.rationale: Both documents govern repository-specific work.

nodes.label: Core artifacts
nodes.rationale: graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md, and graph.html form the shared tracking baseline.

nodes.label: Graph creation approval
nodes.rationale: A missing graph requires explicit approval before creation.

nodes.label: Graphify CLI and skill
nodes.rationale: Complete code/prose builds require both and CLI 0.9.80 or newer.

nodes.label: Host semantic extraction
nodes.rationale: The running agent extracts prose without an external API key.

nodes.label: Local-only artifacts
nodes.rationale: Manifest, caches, runtime metadata, metrics, and snapshots stay out of Git.

nodes.label: Project-specific automation
nodes.rationale: Copying guides does not implement hooks, commands, or accounting helpers.

nodes.label: Tool installation approval
nodes.rationale: Installing, upgrading, user configuration, and hooks need separate authorization.

nodes.label: Code-only update
nodes.rationale: graphify update . is not sufficient after documentation changes.

nodes.label: Headless CLI boundary
nodes.rationale: graphify . --update and graphify extract require external prose backends and are not this skill flow.

nodes.label: PHP parser coverage
nodes.rationale: Some valid PHP 8.5 void casts and enum-qualified match arms may not be modeled.

nodes.label: Preservation on failure
nodes.rationale: Keep the existing graph and report possible staleness.

nodes.label: Refresh success evidence
nodes.rationale: Regenerated graph/report, saved manifest, document coverage, warnings, and usage evidence establish success.

nodes.label: Skill-based incremental refresh
nodes.rationale: Existing graphs refresh code and prose without separate approval or an API key.

nodes.label: Unavailable semantic usage
nodes.rationale: Unmeasured placeholder zeros are not token measurements.

nodes.label: BaseClass attribute
nodes.rationale: The Eightfold BaseClass attribute permits a non-final class only when extension is required and a non-empty rationale explains why.

nodes.label: Subclass attribute
nodes.rationale: The Eightfold Subclass attribute records why extending another class is required; it does not itself permit further extension.

nodes.label: Eightfold\Interfaces\ToString
nodes.rationale: The suite interface extends native Stringable and requires toString(): string; naming both interfaces is permitted but redundant.

nodes.label: Native magic string conversion
nodes.rationale: Providing __toString(), including through inheritance, establishes stringability and the native __toString(): string contract must be fulfilled.

nodes.label: Native Stringable interface
nodes.rationale: PHP's native Stringable interface is one way a class can be stringable.

nodes.label: Suite toString method
nodes.rationale: The ToString interface requires a public toString(): string contract in addition to native magic conversion.

nodes.label: Efqs registration shell
nodes.rationale: The Eightfold Efqs standard registers a shell at src/PHPCS/Efqs/Sniffs/<Category>/<Rule>Sniff.php that delegates to the convention body.

nodes.label: PHPCS convention rule body
nodes.rationale: The implementation resides at src/Analysis/<Convention>/PHPCSSniff.php.

nodes.label: PHPCS diagnostic codes
nodes.rationale: PHPCS derives Efqs.<Category>.<Rule> from the registration shell namespace and Sniff suffix.

nodes.label: PHPCS fixtures
nodes.rationale: Syntactically valid compliant and intentionally noncompliant fixtures describe expected diagnostics and cases that must not be reported.

nodes.label: PHPUnit test metadata
nodes.rationale: Test classes extend a test case and behavioral test methods use snake_case names plus PHPUnit Test and Group attributes.

nodes.label: Composer validation entry points
nodes.rationale: composer check runs check:style, check:analyze, and check:test; composer check:instructions verifies path-specific instruction coverage.

nodes.label: Extension neon configuration
nodes.rationale: extension.neon controls custom PHPStan rule registrations, with lines prefixed by # ignored.

nodes.label: PHPCS ruleset configuration
nodes.rationale: phpcs.xml is the repository's PHPCS ruleset, used by composer check:style; InstanceMethodsMustNotBeAccessedViaThis is registered there.

nodes.label: Repository baseline failures
nodes.rationale: Documented pre-existing style warnings and PHPStan test and fixture type errors should be reported rather than silently fixed outside scope.

nodes.label: Consumer PHPStan extension
nodes.rationale: Consumers include vendor/8fold/php-architecture/extension.neon in their existing PHPStan configuration and set an analysis level.

nodes.label: Contribution guide
nodes.rationale: The contribution guide is the canonical home of qualitative issue triage and change classification.
nodes.source_location: Install contribution policy and templates; Contributing and choosing work

nodes.label: Efqs consumer PHPCS standard
nodes.rationale: Consumers run the suite's Efqs standard against their source; the repository root phpcs.xml is a local ruleset, not the consumer standard.

nodes.label: Independent contract distribution issue 61
nodes.rationale: Issue 61 tracks independent distribution of runtime contracts.

nodes.label: ClassesImplementingStringableMustImplementToString convention
nodes.rationale: The diagnostic help directs the class to implement Eightfold\Interfaces\ToString and its toString(): string method.

nodes.label: Advisory class finality rules
nodes.rationale: The attributes express architectural intent and are recognized by isolated advisory-rule tests, but commented-out registrations mean normal PHPStan analysis does not enforce class finality.

nodes.label: Final concrete classes
nodes.rationale: Concrete classes are final by default, including required subclasses unless they also need extension. Prefer composition to inheritance.

nodes.label: Effective class stringability
nodes.rationale: Classes stringable directly or through a parent, interface, or trait must implement the suite interface directly or indirectly. Traits, interfaces, and enums are not rule targets.

nodes.label: Activation approval
nodes.rationale: A separate explicit approval is required after implementation and before registering the sniff in the repository ruleset.

nodes.label: Fixture approval
nodes.rationale: Explicit approval of fixtures authorizes tests, not implementation or activation.

nodes.label: Isolated PHPCS sniff tests
nodes.rationale: Run the proposed sniff explicitly on fixtures, isolated from unrelated rules, and verify agreed codes, locations, severity, counts, and non-diagnostics before implementation.

nodes.label: PHPCS fixture style exclusion
nodes.rationale: The repository style sweep excludes PHPCS fixtures, but explicit sniff tests still analyze them; intentional violations must remain.

nodes.label: PHPCS ruleset activation
nodes.rationale: Register in phpcs.xml, not extension.neon, run composer check:style, and review violations before changing only approved in-scope code.

nodes.label: PHPCS sniff implementation
nodes.rationale: Implement until approved tests pass without weakening assertions or repairing intentionally noncompliant fixtures.

nodes.label: Test approval
nodes.rationale: Explicit approval of assertions and observed red-test results authorizes implementation but not activation.

nodes.label: Behavioral package tests
nodes.rationale: Test behavior implemented by the package rather than re-testing PHP or third-party mechanisms; use external analyzers as tools for convention detection.

nodes.label: Convention diagnostic assertions
nodes.rationale: Compliant inputs should produce no diagnostics and genuinely violating inputs should produce agreed diagnostics; metadata-only and third-party-mechanism assertions do not substitute for behavior coverage.

nodes.label: Valid red test evidence
nodes.rationale: A meaningful red test fails its intended assertion; missing rule classes, syntax errors, autoload failures, and runner errors are setup failures instead.

nodes.label: Avoid generated churn
nodes.rationale: Regenerated artifacts such as graphs, caches, and compiled assets should stay out of unrelated commits.

nodes.label: Change classification
nodes.rationale: Each small commit is either a behavior-and-contract-preserving refactoring or a re-engineering that changes observable behavior or an explicit developer-facing contract.

nodes.label: Completion evidence
nodes.rationale: Claims of completed changes require same-turn edits and must report git status, diff names, and all changed paths, including untracked files.

nodes.label: Graph first startup
nodes.rationale: Check the knowledge graph before reading the shared rules and context; query it before broad navigation, while verifying source before edits.

nodes.label: Guidance is not enforcement
nodes.rationale: A documented rule is not evidence that a tool enforces it, and guidance does not authorize unrelated repository-wide refactoring.

nodes.label: Human gated pull requests
nodes.rationale: Opening a new pull request ordinarily requires human approval, while updates to an existing pull request do not; merging requires an explicit user request.

nodes.label: One home per fact
nodes.rationale: Each fact or procedure has a canonical home; paraphrases should link back without changing meaning, and local adaptations belong in the repository agent context.

nodes.label: Secret protection
nodes.rationale: Never read, search, or output actual environment files or credentials; only named secret-free templates and explicitly directed secret copies are exceptions.

nodes.label: Test refactoring
nodes.rationale: Remove scaffolding and redundant language or third-party tests when behavior remains covered, without trading coverage for a green build.

nodes.label: Convention analysis layout
nodes.rationale: Convention folders contain PHPStan or PHPCS implementations and named diagnostic templates; missing templates and unresolved placeholders raise errors and templates are not cached.

nodes.label: Fixture only draft pull request exception
nodes.norm_label: fixture only draft pull request exception
nodes.rationale: A convention request authorizes an initial fixture-only draft pull request without separate approval; later workflow approval gates remain.

nodes.label: Graph refresh policy
nodes.rationale: The existing graph is refreshed without separate approval; composer graph:code refreshes code only, semantic documentation needs the Graphify workflow, and core graph artifacts are committed while local-only files are ignored.
nodes.source_location: Build, test, and lint commands; Local adaptations and pending deliverables

nodes.label: PHPStan fixture exclusion
nodes.rationale: Repository-wide PHPStan analysis excludes fixtures, while isolated tests still analyze the stringability fixtures.

nodes.label: Stringability rule activation
nodes.rationale: The stringability PHPStan rule is active in extension.neon alongside a vendor extension; the other custom PHPStan rule registrations remain commented out.

nodes.label: Agent instruction layer
nodes.rationale: Every convention has an agent-instruction layer whose applicable instruction coverage must pass composer check:instructions.

nodes.label: Analyzer selection tradeoffs
nodes.rationale: Recommend optional layers only when benefits outweigh costs, considering accuracy, overlap, existing violations, and whether suggested fixes preserve behavior.

nodes.label: Convention layers
nodes.rationale: Assess the agent-instruction, PHPCS, PHPStan, trait, and interface layers and record why any layer or stage is skipped.

nodes.label: Convention tracking
nodes.rationale: Track all layers in one convention issue, update an existing issue rather than duplicate it, and do not treat issue creation as a prerequisite or implementation approval.

nodes.label: PHPCS token analysis
nodes.rationale: Use a PHPCS sniff when a convention can be detected from tokens alone without type information.

nodes.label: PHPStan semantic analysis
nodes.rationale: Use a PHPStan rule when detection needs types, symbols, or semantic analysis; absent a separate documented process, follow the sniff stages and approval gates.

nodes.label: Trait and interface layers
nodes.rationale: Add a trait when a shared implementation supports a convention, and an interface when a shared contract supports it.

nodes.label: Code only graph refresh
nodes.rationale: composer graph:code refreshes code only; documentation still requires a semantic refresh through the Graphify workflow.
nodes.source_location: Refresh code in this repository's knowledge graph

nodes.label: Consumer dependency boundaries
nodes.rationale: Composer ignores a dependency's require-dev, so the suite declares analysis tools in require; they remain development-only when the suite itself is a consumer development dependency unless needed elsewhere.

nodes.label: Runtime contracts
nodes.rationale: Application classes implementing a suite interface require that contract when PHP loads them, so a runtime consumer cannot omit the suite with composer install --no-dev.

nodes.label: Safe documentation copy commands
nodes.rationale: The efqs copy commands create directories as needed, leave identical destinations unchanged, and refuse to overwrite different files; copying guides does not install Graphify or create a graph.
